newsitem.title: INDIA: India IDBI down 6.5 pct on weak 1st half.
newsitem.headline: India IDBI down 6.5 pct on weak 1st half.

text.p: Shares of Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI) slid 6.75 rupees or 6.54 percent to 96.50 rupees on the Bombay bourse on Friday after the firm's first half results fell below expectations, traders said.
IDBI said on Thursday its first half net rose a modest 2.0 percent to 5,140 million rupees in the six months to September 30, 1996.

The finance firm said net profit would have been higher but for the impact of the loss of interest income of 200 million rupees due to non-utilisation of excess subscription received for one of its bond issues earlier this year.
Higher depreciation, particularly on account of leased assets also restricted the net profit, it said.
